Derek, saw UserGems repositioned as the AI Command Center for outbound and launched Brains of GTM with Snowflake and Datadog leaders.

You know signal-based GTM better than most, so you also know the catch: there are always more in-market accounts than reps can touch. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own on top of those signals, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for UserGems off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Derek, quick follow-up for UserGems.

As the AI Command Center story drives demand, the target climbs faster than you can ramp, and even signal-led teams often cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap shows up late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings UserGems needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Derek, last bit of proof for UserGems.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how UserGems' reply rate likely compares to other signal-led GTM teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to UserGems either way.
